tab.signingServer: Being signed: the version of {{date}} (route on the server)
tab.hint: Signers see this version, not the current build. Editing and rebuilding the document do not change it.
tab.differs: There are changes since the document was sent for signing. Signers sign the version of {{date}}, which does not include the current build.
tab.heldActive: While the document is on a signing route, the current build cannot be signed. Send a new version or cancel the route on the Signing card.
tab.heldCompleted: The route is complete and still tracks the document. Send a new version or stop tracking the route on the Signing card.
tab.confirmText: Signatures placed on the version of {{date}} will no longer match the document.
tab.confirmLocal: If the route on the server is still running, it will stop.
tab.done: The document is now signed from the current build
tab.failed: Could not remove the version for signing: {{reason}}

pack.before: “{{name}}” changed after it was sent for signing: the package will get the version for signing of {{date}}
pack.after: “{{name}}” changed after it was sent for signing: the package got the version for signing of {{date}}
pack.sendNewVersionHint: Opens the Signing card with this document's route
